chapter.name: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
chapter.englishName: Yoga of the Division of the Three Gunas
chapter.description: Krishna explains the three fundamental qualities (gunas) of nature—Sattva (purity), Rajas (activity), and Tamas (inertia)—and how they influence human behavior, consciousness, and spiritual evolution.
chapter.theme: Understanding the three gunas and transcending them for liberation
chapter.yogaType: Jnana Yoga - Analysis of Nature and Qualities

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम् | यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | paraṃ bhūyaḥ pravakṣyāmi jñānānāṃ jñānam uttamam | yaj jñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhim ito gatāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: I will again explain the supreme knowledge, knowing which sages attained perfection.
verses.meaning: Krishna introduces the highest wisdom about nature.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः | सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च ||
verses.transliteration: idaṃ jñānam upāśritya mama sādharmyam āgatāḥ | sarge 'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca ||
verses.english_translation: Those who realize this knowledge attain My nature and are free from birth and death.
verses.meaning: Knowledge leads to liberation from cycles.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम् | सम्भवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत ||
verses.transliteration: mama yonir mahad brahma tasmin garbhaṃ dadhāmy aham | sambhavaḥ sarva-bhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata ||
verses.english_translation: Nature is My womb; I seed all beings within it.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः सम्भवन्ति याः | तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-yoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ sambhavanti yāḥ | tāsāṃ brahma mahad yonir ahaṃ bīja-pradaḥ pitā ||
verses.english_translation: I am the seed-giving father of all living beings.
verses.meaning: Krishna is the origin of all life.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः | निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम् ||
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ rajas tama iti guṇāḥ prakṛti-sambhavāḥ | nibadhnanti mahā-bāho dehe dehinam avyayam ||
verses.english_translation: The three gunas—Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas—bind the soul to the body.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् | सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ ||
verses.transliteration: tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvāt prakāśakam anāmayam | sukha-saṅgena badhnāti jñāna-saṅgena cānagha ||
verses.english_translation: Sattva is pure and luminous but binds through attachment to happiness and knowledge.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् | तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम् ||
verses.transliteration: rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇā-saṅga-samudbhavam | tan nibadhnāti kaunteya karma-saṅgena dehinam ||
verses.english_translation: Rajas is driven by passion and binds through action and desire.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् | प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत ||
verses.transliteration: tamas tv ajñāna-jaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarva-dehinām | pramādālasya-nidrābhis tan nibadhnāti bhārata ||
verses.english_translation: Tamas arises from ignorance and binds through laziness and delusion.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत | ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत ||
verses.transliteration: sattvaṃ sukhe sañjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata | jñānam āvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde sañjayaty uta ||
verses.english_translation: Sattva leads to happiness, Rajas to action, and Tamas to ignorance.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत | रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा ||
verses.transliteration: rajas tamaś cābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhārata | rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaś caiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajas tathā ||
verses.english_translation: Sometimes one guna dominates over the others.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते | ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्यात्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत ||
verses.transliteration: sarva-dvāreṣu dehe 'smin prakāśa upajāyate | jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyāt vivṛddhaṃ sattvam ity uta ||
verses.english_translation: When knowledge shines, Sattva is dominant.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा | रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ ||
verses.transliteration: lobhaḥ pravṛttir ārambhaḥ karmaṇām aśamaḥ spṛhā | rajasy etāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha ||
verses.english_translation: Greed, activity, and restlessness arise when Rajas dominates.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च | तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन ||
verses.transliteration: aprakāśo 'pravṛttiś ca pramādo moha eva ca | tamasy etāni jāyante vivṛddhe kuru-nandana ||
verses.english_translation: Darkness, inactivity, and confusion arise from Tamas.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् | तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते ||
verses.transliteration: yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti deha-bhṛt | tadottama-vidāṃ lokān amalān pratipadyate ||
verses.english_translation: One who dies in Sattva attains higher realms.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते | तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते ||
verses.transliteration: rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karma-saṅgiṣu jāyate | tathā pralīnas tamasi mūḍha-yoniṣu jāyate ||
verses.english_translation: One who dies in Rajas is reborn among active people; in Tamas among the ignorant.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् | रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम् ||
verses.transliteration: karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam | rajasas tu phalaṃ duḥkham ajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam ||
verses.english_translation: The result of Sattvic actions is pure; Rajasic actions bring suffering, and Tamasic actions result in ignorance.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वात्सञ्जायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च | प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च ||
verses.transliteration: sattvāt sañjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca | pramāda-mohau tamaso bhavato 'jñānam eva ca ||
verses.english_translation: From Sattva arises knowledge, from Rajas greed, and from Tamas ignorance.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः | जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः ||
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattva-sthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ | jaghanya-guṇa-vṛtti-sthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those in Sattva rise upward, those in Rajas remain in the middle, and those in Tamas fall downward.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति | गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति ||
verses.transliteration: nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati | guṇebhyaś ca paraṃ vetti mad-bhāvaṃ so 'dhigacchati ||
verses.english_translation: One who sees that only gunas act and knows the Supreme beyond them attains Me.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् | जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते ||
verses.transliteration: guṇān etān atītya trīn dehī deha-samudbhavān | janma-mṛtyu-jarā-duḥkhair vimukto 'mṛtam aśnute ||
verses.english_translation: Transcending the three gunas, one becomes free from birth and death and attains immortality.
verses.meaning: Freedom comes by rising above nature.

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो | किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | kair liṅgais trīn guṇān etān atīto bhavati prabho | kim ācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃs trīn guṇān ativartate ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna asked: What are the signs of one who transcends the gunas?

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव | न द्वेष्टि सम्प्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca moham eva ca pāṇḍava | na dveṣṭi sampravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati ||
verses.english_translation: One who neither hates nor desires the gunas is beyond them.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते | गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येवं योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते ||
verses.transliteration: udāsīna-vad āsīno guṇair yo na vicālyate | guṇā vartanta ity evaṃ yo 'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate ||
verses.english_translation: Remaining neutral and undisturbed by gunas, one stays steady.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः | तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः ||
verses.transliteration: sama-duḥkha-sukhaḥ sva-sthaḥ sama-loṣṭāśma-kāñcanaḥ | tulya-priyāpriyo dhīras tulya-nindātma-saṃstutiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Equal in pleasure and pain, honor and dishonor, one remains balanced.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः | सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: mānāpamānayos tulyas tulyo mitrāri-pakṣayoḥ | sarvārambha-parityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: Equal in honor and dishonor, friend and foe, one is beyond gunas.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते | स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ||
verses.transliteration: māṃ ca yo 'vyabhicāreṇa bhakti-yogena sevate | sa guṇān samatītyaitān brahma-bhūyāya kalpate ||
verses.english_translation: Through unwavering devotion, one transcends the gunas and attains Brahman.
verses.meaning: Bhakti is the path beyond nature.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च | शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च ||
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāham amṛtasyāvyayasya ca | śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca ||
verses.english_translation: I am the foundation of the eternal Brahman and ultimate bliss.
